changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Before this release a GitLab issue or merge request pass that stopped at the page cap counted as complete, so its monitor's issues_synced_at or pull_requests_synced_at moved to the end of the pass while repository.last_sync_at held. GitLab sync now reads each kind from its own watermark, which would skip what such a pass never reached. So every GitLab monitor starts from its project's last_sync_at, the one watermark the earlier releases kept correct; this costs one extra read and skips nothing.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE repository_to_monitor rtm SET issues_synced_at = r.last_sync_at, pull_requests_synced_at = r.last_sync_at FROM repository r JOIN identity_provider p ON p.id = r.provider_id AND p.type = 'GITLAB' WHERE rtm.native_id = r.native_id AND rtm.name_with_owner = r.name_with_owner AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connection c WHERE c.workspace_id = rtm.workspace_id AND c.kind = 'GITLAB' AND c.config ->> 'serverUrl' = p.server_url);

rollback.stop: The earlier issue and merge request watermarks of GitLab monitors are not kept. Restore the database backup taken before this upgrade to bring them back.
